name: sleeper
framing: One man lying asleep on his side on the ground, curled up with his knees drawn in, seen from the side, his head to the left resting on a rolled-up coat, worn boots sticking out at the right. Even, soft, frontal lighting with no cast shadows, no rim light and no glow halos. Transparent background, the whole figure in frame with a little space around it, no ground, no text, no border.
prompt: A homeless man in his sixties asleep on the pavement under a wet, stained blanket of faded patchwork, only his grey-stubbled face, one hand and his scuffed boots showing. Like everyone, he wears a partial helmet over one eye: a heavy, grey, steampunk-like device of riveted metal plates and a round lens. An empty bottle lies by his boots.
